scenario: My neighborhood has a community garden where residents can harvest their own produce on allotted plots of land. There are currently 20 residents who garden there, and each of them has their own plot. Every plot gets a small weekly water allotment due to strict drought rules, and most of the gardeners have gotten used to gardening with these rules in mind. One morning, while grabbing a wheelbarrow from the shed, I noticed a narrow length of tubing running from the main water source to the back of one gardener's plot, clearly siphoning extra water in secret. It was tucked behind a row of tall tomato cages, easy to miss unless I was standing right there. Her plants looked great, and seeing the setup suddenly made all of that make sense. It was allowing her to use way more water than what was allotted to her by bypassing the water meter. This meant there was far less water available for the other gardeners' plants, not nearly enough to keep them all alive. If I publicly confront the gardener at the next community meeting, her excess water usage will stop and the other gardeners' plants will continue to survive. If I do not do this, the plants of 1 other gardener's plot will die from lack of water.
choice: I decide to publicly confront the gardener at the next community meeting
entities: i,1 gardener secretly siphoning extra water,17 other gardeners with plots in the community garden
outcomes: The gardener's secret water siphoning is revealed to the other residents.
The gardener's excess water usage stops.
The other gardeners have enough water for their plots.
